opening.argument: The speaker promotes OneCoin by linking participation to rising prices and the prospect of a fortune. He urges listeners to join, buy education, and put tokens into mining, presenting a time-limited opportunity in which incomes will double and the coin price will rise. The appeal to future wealth is explicit: “Man, you must have made a fortune.” He also claims holders will be able to sell in two or three years and suggests OneCoin could become a reserve currency. These claims support a scam finding because they encourage participation through anticipated financial rewards, while the available video evidence establishes no actual earnings, liquidity, adoption, or completed transactions.
